notes.title: Build 909
notes.content:
The first patch for the Steam version of Cross Racing Championship Extreme has been released.

Build 909 contains the following:
[list]
[*]Set up Steam Cloud, syncing career progress, control settings, Time Trial results and replays between PCs.
[*]Fixed a startup crash occurring when using any languages other than English. This crash affected mostly Windows 7 users, but technically could have affected everyone.
[*]Fixed a possible crash in a JVM.
[*]Build 908 introduced a /LARGEADDRESSAWARE flag, allowing the game to use a 4GB address space. However, this could cause crashes when compiling scripts, so it has now been reverted to how it was in non-Steam versions.
[*]Corrected names and country codes of several AI drivers.
[*]Improved diag.log memory status logging - it now logs amount of physical RAM correctly on all devices.
[/list]

Cheers,
CRC Support Team.

notes.title: Multiplayer guide
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33489036/d3c76d7028f91ab858186ff7dfd9b867f2df6a2e.jpg[/img]

The game has a multiplayer mode, but you might have difficulties with figuring out how it works, because back in 2005 it was designed to work with ASE (a master server-like service defunct since 2008) and LAN and that's something different from today's reality.

[b]Medek[/b] from CRC community has released a multiplayer guide to help you with this! You'll need Hamachi for this:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1520034779]LINK TO THE GUIDE[/url]

If it didn't help, please, let us know in the comments!

[b]Invictus Games[/b] has also commented on a prospect of a modern, Steam based multiplayer:

[quote]We are considering adding Steam based online multiplayer. It depends how succesful the game is going to be. If there's a bigger demand for it, we can add such a feature.
[/quote]

As evidenced, it may or may not arrive at some point in the future! It all depends on your reception!

notes.title: CRC is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33489036/9705717fd909b5e7a6c3de75ce7aeb66ab95b224.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We're glad to tell you that Cross Racing Championship officially returns today in an Extreme edition for Steam!

Expecting to release modding tools, examples and documentation soon as well! If you have any suggestions or you've faced with the bug, please, let us know in the comments.

[i]Best regards,
CRC Support Team.[/i]
